minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  January 11, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900 -6833,
meeting ID: 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on January 11, 2024 at 2:39 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reginald Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Raul Fernandez / Boytrese Osias, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services & Public Safety

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Larrance Dopson DBA Walls Annenber to host a 1500 or Nothin Day Celebration
  Event at 8729 Aviation Blvd.; Private Property, on Monday, January 15, 2024, from
  12:00 pm – 11:00 pm –APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS; Applicant to hire (10) Licensed Professional
  Security Guards for public safety; (3) Security Guards are to remain posted at the
  Beer Garden during the event to ensure there will be no alcohol sold to minors;
  Applicant to submit a one day ABC License to IPD for approval; The event to be held
  at 8729 Aviation (only); No obstruction of the sidewalk; Attendees must use UBER/
  Lyft for drop off / pick-up service (only); Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and
  face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and
  CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00383466).
 Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
